name: Shiranuka (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shiranuka town emblem in yellow: a broken ring enclosing an outlined five-pointed star with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shiranuka, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 1950.

features.role: Shiranuka town emblem — a broken ring enclosing an outlined five-pointed star with a disc
